constitutive_commitments: empirical-unit and measurement identity; exact filter/risk set; no analytic similarity
method_variant_examples: index, storage layout, exact query engine
split_triggers: filter changes claim/risk set; derived equivalence/order enters
claim_relevance_rule: admit only for claim slots answerable directly from governed substrate
